commands: set -euo pipefail; ADB=/opt/homebrew/bin/adb; echo BRANCH_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo ORIGIN_MAIN=$(git rev-parse origin/main); echo DEVICES_BEGIN; "$ADB" devices -l; echo DEVICES_END; TARGET=RFCT70L7E8J; test "$("$ADB" -s "$TARGET" get-state)" = device; echo ADB_TRANSPORT=usb; echo ADB_TARGET=$TARGET; echo DEVICE_MODEL=$("$ADB" -s "$TARGET" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); echo PACKAGE_INFO_BEGIN; "$ADB" -s "$TARGET" shell dumpsys package link.localclimate.app | grep -E 'versionName=|versionCode=|lastUpdateTime=' | head -10 | tr -d '\r'; echo PACKAGE_INFO_END; echo PID=$("$ADB" -s "$TARGET" shell pidof link.localclimate.app | tr -d '\r' || true)
